meta.name: create-creator-takes-h3
meta.description: Generate an AI creator talking to camera, saying an approved script, as one continuous track — H3 Max reference-to-video through the GooseWorks fal-proxy (bills the Ads agent). Plans takes on line boundaries under H3's 15s cap, dry-runs a cost estimate, generates the first take alone so its voice can be locked and passed to every later take, joins takes with measured 0.10s dissolves, and moves each line's timing onto the words actually spoken. Use for any format with a generated creator speaking a script (split-screen, screen inserts, talking-head ads).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的口播脚本变成 AI 主播出镜的连贯视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要用虚拟主播对镜头念完脚本拍广告或宣传片
copy.tagline_en: Turn a written script into a continuous on-camera AI creator video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need an AI creator to deliver a script on camera for ads

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你的台词按行切成每段 15 秒以内的多个片段,先生成第一段并锁定它的声音,再用 0.10 秒叠化把各段拼成一条连续视频,最后把台词时间对齐到实际说出的词。
howto.when: 当你要做由生成创作者对着镜头念稿的视频时会接管,比如分屏、屏幕插入、口播广告等格式;它也会先让你确认一张人物定妆图再开始生成。

say.text: 用这份台词和人物设定,帮我规划分段并跑一次成本预估
say.note: 只做规划与估价,不产生费用

say.text: 先只生成第一段,我确认声音后再继续剩下的
say.note: 后续每段都会复制第一段的声音

say.text: 把这些片段用 0.10 秒叠化拼成一条完整视频
say.note: 输出一条连续的创作者轨道

howto.what_en: After install, Claude splits a script into takes under 15s each, generates the first take alone to lock its voice, joins takes with 0.10s dissolves into one continuous track, then aligns line timings to the spoken words.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you need a generated creator speaking a script on camera - split-screen, screen inserts, talking-head ads, etc. It shows a character still before any take.

say_en.text: Plan takes from this script and character file, and dry-run the cost
say_en.note: Dry run only; nothing is billed.

say_en.text: Generate only the first take so I can approve its voice
Join the takes with 0.10s dissolves into one video
